basis: Confirmed audit finding A3: V1 public history aliases actor/sizing/provenance and is not information-preserving.
Confirmed audit finding: legal public histories can exceed the frozen 32-event V1/V2 window.

The existing solver ABI already returns neural payload size and accepts caller buffer capacity, so a variable-length V3 wire is mechanically possible; no strategic truncation cap is required by ABI design.
Phase 1 is explicitly diagnostic-only and has no selection authority.

H0_FIXED_V1.reason: Retains confirmed lossy V1 public-history representation.

H1_RELATIONAL_EXACT.reason: Fixes card symmetry but deliberately retains confirmed lossy V1 public-history representation.

mandatory_delta_from_phase1_prototype: Use complete variable-length structured public history; no last-N strategic truncation.
Use packed/masked recurrent processing with padding provably neutral.
Materialize a versioned C++ V3 wire and Python decoder with exact parity tests.
Retain exact current state and lossless relational card state up to true game symmetries.
Replace known-bad/overloaded old-V2 semantic fields rather than merely excluding some of them.
Use pairwise opponent stack/effective-stack/SPR geometry with explicit present/contesting/actionable masks.
No physical suit IDs or ordered-hole-card semantic fields.
Use objective hand/draw/board relations; no subjective Good/Mid/Weak draw labels.
Correct wheel-edge 2345 OESD semantics and add exhaustive/property coverage for straight/flush draw descriptors.

H4_HYBRID_CAPACITY_FINAL.reason: Governed by parent Phase 3 admission; may run only after H3 final structural/resource screen.

history_contract.network_batching: pad only to batch-local maximum and use explicit lengths/packing
history_contract.corruption_guard: An implementation may have a protocol/sanity maximum for malformed input, but reaching it in a legal frozen production profile is a hard error, not silent truncation.

selection_guard: Phase 1 H0/H1 diagnostic superiority, if observed, cannot override these structural admission rules. Phase 2 must compare corrected production-eligible candidates on candidate-specific end-to-end learning evidence.
